'''Grancha Lakand''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. While Lakand was exploring a fissure in search of [[Venenit queshaaga|Quesh venom]], a valuable chemical found on Quesh, Lakand became trapped by a rockfall. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] he had been rescued, Lakand's [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] countermeasures to the poisonous [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Quesh had worn off, and he had been breathing venom fumes for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. Lakand told his rescuers that he believed the planet's largest supply of Quesh venom lay below the fissure, and though he was initially dismissed as a crazed madman, Lakand returned to the fissure after recovering and&mdash;after weeks surveying&mdash;discovered a large reservoir of venom. The [[Grancha Lakand venom mine|Grancha Lakand Venom Mine]] was built to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] the reservoir, providing the Republic with venom for several years.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grancha Lakand was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Grancha Lakand Venom Mine in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
